messages.author: h_sahakyan.mb.sci.am
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
Is it possible to use dihedral restrains to make the rotation along with phy/psy angles in one direction easier than in another?
OR
How one can modify a force field to do it?
Thanks in advance,
Harutyun Sahakyan
Senior Assistant at Laboratory of
Computational Modeling of Biological Processes,
Institute of Molecular Biology, NAS RA
7 Hasratyan St, Yerevan, Armenia
Tel: +374 93 323990
E-mail: h_sahakyan.mb.sci.am (mailto:h_sahakyan.mb.sci.am)

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Sep 30, 2020, h_sahakyan.mb.sci.am wrote:
>
> Is it possible to use dihedral restrains to make the rotation along with
> phy/psy angles in one direction easier than in another?
Please see Chapter 27.1 ("Distance, angle and torsional restraints") in
the Amber Reference Manual.
....dac
